name: web-txt2img (WebSD / SD-Turbo in browser)
description: Browser library running SD-Turbo via WebGPU; closest real match to the author's 'WebSD / sd-1-5-webgpu', which could not be verified as named.

restrictions: Library MIT, but SD-Turbo weights carry the Stability community licence
license.notes: 'WebSD' exists only as a Hugging Face space (silait/sd-web); no 'sd-1-5-webgpu' package found. Microsoft's onnxruntime-inference-examples js/sd-turbo is the official demo.

cost.notes: ~2.3 GB weights downloaded to the browser; requires WebGPU.

verdictReason: Proves in-browser diffusion is feasible; far too heavy and licence-encumbered for default use.
